verdict: Approved after revision, before training and held-out games
strongest_objection: Trying to eat on the first turn gives the blind policy an avoidable failure on a publicly known empty founder. Random eat/move alone also conflates the sensor with a good search schedule.
resolution: Move first on the blind alternating schedule, retain an equal-class random blind control, group seeds by exact structure across both laws, exclude development and replay classes, transport actual moves under a name permutation, and run until death. The two scripts test named policies.
additional_advisor: Fable 5.2 returned a weekly account limit. The separately consulted Astra Max supplied the independent prospective verdict.
